title: Fix two clippy errors in kith-store
description: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings fails in kith-store (found 2026-10-30): (1) lib.rs:1255 'new_counter >= i64::MAX' — clippy says the comparison is always true or false for one case; it is effectively '== i64::MAX', so check whether the overflow guard does what was meant. (2) space.rs:475 type_complexity; factor into a type alias.
